songs.title: Lum mak lang mei ning tou lana
songs.titleRongmei: Lum mak lang mei ning tou lana

verification.note: Transcribed from supplied PDF, printed song number 1. Original spelling and line breaks are kept where text extraction permits.

lines: 1. Lum mak lang mei ning tou lana.
Lung geina phu tat re theimu;
Kalvary khou tei hou puni.
Aniu khang rui thei lou meipu
Kanloumeipu ta.
He guanga thuano khang loumei puta.
Rian ramei lat nzan luai na.
Kandimei nuan phung ngam kan the.
Zaukim makmei pu.
2. Gaimak khang tei rana sulou.
Su kasih khang ningmei nun rui.
Roman rimei kheisi meirui,
Su kasi sihna su kan the.
Kanloumeipu ta.
3. Lu suan mei guay guang kariu o.
Poubaomei ta rak nduang khang.
Ruak naipui kam tei kao lana.
Ntam khang tei thuan ku dikho.
4. Pouta ning mei zing bang dak khou,
Kamei theimei ta houlana.
Mikdui luan laina kap meipui,
Ringthao dat mei tei hou lana,
Kap tan dat kan the.

lines: 1. Zingmei gaanc patro Aram nzuan ni.

Gaanc guang o Poubaomei achaeng maan the.
Lung zing mei le tarou rui gumliam the.
4. Ai ringhmei panti tarou khou ruina.
Kanloumei nun nkhuan pui bam zuan ni.
Duikhuan chumak mei khou ai zaeng thaek ni.

lines: 1. Kalvary khou zauzian loumei tei.

Ndao khap diu zaat guai nakhou.

2. Ai rui rianra rian riu bam khou hei,
Thou cho, poubaomei ata kanlou khang?

3. Kandi nkhuai mei muang zing meikum.
Zing guang e poubaomei alung khou hei,

Nzianmei guai tingsaeng lung nipui ram,
Kap bammei hei tabui nung rui,
Neihla mikdui phui datni cho.?
